name: NLAlib.condExp_re_trace_exp_add_le
statement:
theorem condExp_re_trace_exp_add_le (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {H X : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜}
    (hHm : StronglyMeasurable[m] H) (hH : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (H ω).IsHermitian)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian) (hint : Integrable (fun ω => exp (X ω)) μ) :
    μ[fun ω => RCLike.re (exp (H ω + X ω)).trace | m] ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun ω => RCLike.re (exp (H ω + cfc Real.log (μ[fun ω => exp (X ω) | m] ω))).trace

  [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hm : m ≤ mΩ) {H X : Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜} (hHm : StronglyMeasurable H)
  (hH : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, (H ω).IsHermitian) (hX : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, (X ω).IsHermitian)

name: NLAlib.HasCondMatrixMGFBound.supermartingale_re_trace_exp
statement:
theorem supermartingale_re_trace_exp (hX : ∀ j, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (j + 1)] (X j))
    (h : ∀ j, HasCondMatrixMGFBound (ℱ j) (X j) g (A j) s μ) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : θ ∈ s)
    (hint : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => RCLike.re (exp (θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω -
      g θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω)).trace) μ) :
    Supermartingale (fun k ω => RCLike.re (exp (θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω -
      g θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω)).trace) ℱ μ

  {n : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ} {X A : ℕ → Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜}

            (θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω - g θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω)).trace)
    ℱ μ

name: NLAlib.HasCondMatrixMGFBound.measureReal_exists_eigenvalue_zero_sum_ge_le
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_eigenvalue_zero_sum_ge_le [Nonempty n]
    (hX : ∀ j, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (j + 1)] (X j))
    (h : ∀ j, HasCondMatrixMGFBound (ℱ j) (X j) g (A j) s μ) {θ : ℝ} (hθs : θ ∈ s)
    (hθ : 0 < θ) (hg : 0 ≤ g θ)
    (hint : ∀ k, Integrable (fun ω => RCLike.re (exp (θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω -
      g θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω)).trace) μ) (t w : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k, t ≤ eigenvalue (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω) 0 ∧
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω ≤ w • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)} ≤
      Fintype.card n * Real.exp (-θ * t + g θ * w)
signature:
NLAlib.HasCondMatrixMGFBound.measureReal_exists_eigenvalue_zero_sum_ge_le.{u_1, u_2, u_3}
  {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {𝕜 : Type u_2}
  [RCLike 𝕜] {n : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ}
  {X A : ℕ → Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} [Nonempty n]
  (hX : ∀ (j : ℕ), StronglyMeasurable (X j))
  (h : ∀ (j : ℕ), HasCondMatrixMGFBound (↑ℱ j) (X j) g (A j) s μ) {θ : ℝ} (hθs : θ ∈ s) (hθ : 0 < θ)
  (hg : 0 ≤ g θ)
  (hint :
    ∀ (k : ℕ),
      Integrable
        (fun ω ↦
          RCLike.re
            (NormedSpace.exp
                (θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω - g θ • ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω)).trace)
        μ)
  (t w : ℝ) :
  μ.real
      {ω |
        ∃ k, t ≤ eigenvalue (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω) 0 ∧ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, A j ω ≤ w • 1} ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card n) * rexp (-θ * t + g θ * w)

name: NLAlib.measureReal_exists_eigenvalue_zero_sum_ge_le_freedman
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_eigenvalue_zero_sum_ge_le_freedman [Nonempty n]
    {X : ℕ → Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜} (hX : ∀ j, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (j + 1)] (X j))
    (hX2 : ∀ j, MemLp (X j) 2 μ) (hmean : ∀ j, μ[X j | ℱ j] =ᵐ[μ] 0) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hle : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X j ω ≤ L • (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜)) {t v : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k, t ≤ eigenvalue (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω) 0 ∧
        specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, μ[fun ω' => X j ω' ^ 2 | ℱ j] ω) ≤ v} ≤
      Fintype.card n * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))

NLAlib.measureReal_exists_eigenvalue_zero_sum_ge_le_freedman.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {Ω : Type u_1}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {𝕜 : Type u_2} [RCLike 𝕜]
  {n : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ} [Nonempty n]
  {X : ℕ → Ω → Matrix n n 𝕜} (hX : ∀ (j : ℕ), StronglyMeasurable (X j))
  (hX2 : ∀ (j : ℕ), MemLp (X j) 2 μ) (hmean : ∀ (j : ℕ), μ[X j | ↑ℱ j] =ᵐ[μ] 0) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
  (hle : ∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, X j ω ≤ L • 1) {t v : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
  μ.real
      {ω |
        ∃ k,
          t ≤ eigenvalue (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, X j ω) 0 ∧
            specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, μ[fun ω' ↦ X j ω' ^ 2 | ↑ℱ j] ω) ≤ v} ≤
    ↑(Fintype.card n) * rexp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))

name: NLAlib.measureReal_exists_specNorm_sum_ge_le_freedman
statement:
theorem measureReal_exists_specNorm_sum_ge_le_freedman [Nonempty n] {r : Type*} [Fintype r]
    [DecidableEq r] {S : ℕ → Ω → Matrix r n 𝕜} (hS : ∀ j, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ (j + 1)] (S j))
    (hS2 : ∀ j, MemLp (S j) 2 μ) (hmean : ∀ j, μ[S j | ℱ j] =ᵐ[μ] 0) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hle : ∀ j, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, specNorm (S j ω) ≤ L) {t v : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k, t ≤ specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, S j ω) ∧
        max (specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, μ[fun ω' => S j ω' * (S j ω')ᴴ | ℱ j] ω))
          (specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, μ[fun ω' => (S j ω')ᴴ * S j ω' | ℱ j] ω)) ≤ v} ≤
      (Fintype.card r + Fintype.card n) * Real.exp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))

  {n : Type u_3} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ} [Nonempty n] {r : Type u_4}
  [Fintype r] [DecidableEq r] {S : ℕ → Ω → Matrix r n 𝕜} (hS : ∀ (j : ℕ), StronglyMeasurable (S j))
  (hS2 : ∀ (j : ℕ), MemLp (S j) 2 μ) (hmean : ∀ (j : ℕ), μ[S j | ↑ℱ j] =ᵐ[μ] 0) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L)
  (hle : ∀ (j : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, specNorm (S j ω) ≤ L) {t v : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
  μ.real
      {ω |
        ∃ k,
          t ≤ specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, S j ω) ∧
            max (specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, μ[fun ω' ↦ S j ω' * (S j ω')ᴴ | ↑ℱ j] ω))
                (specNorm (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, μ[fun ω' ↦ (S j ω')ᴴ * S j ω' | ↑ℱ j] ω)) ≤
              v} ≤
    (↑(Fintype.card r) + ↑(Fintype.card n)) * rexp (-(t ^ 2 / 2) / (v + L * t / 3))
